text:
A photograph inside a light-grey enclosure with aluminium extrusion framing on the left and a white machine column at centre-rear, carrying a yellow label and a white cylindrical fitting near the top.

At centre-right, a white and dark-grey robotic arm extends diagonally from the lower foreground upward to the left. Its end holds a green rectangular circuit board or panel with a small white square marking; a black cable runs from the board's right edge down to the right.

Behind the green panel sits a red/orange cylindrical spool or bobbin on a black bracket mounted on a white block. A black cable and a blue-tipped connector lie on the floor at the right. The grey floor shows scattered small pale specks and debris.
